title: Existence and Stability of Dancing Equilibria in Asymmetric Kuramoto Networks
summary: We study nonzero-frequency phase-locked motions in asymmetrically coupled Kuramoto networks. Such motions are relative equilibria with fixed phase differences and a nonzero common angular velocity, and we call them dancing equilibria. Their existence requires all coupling sums to have the same nonzero value. We show that neither symmetric coupling nor an acyclic associated digraph can support a dancing equilibrium.
